explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/660: in [Er75f] Erdős claims (without reference) that Altman proved that polyhedron vertices determine ≫ n distinct distances. The statement is ∃ c > 0 such that eventually every n-vertex 3-dimensional convex polytope vertex set has ≥ c·n distinct distances. It is tagged open since no proof is known, which is reasonable. Faithful.
